subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): add timeouts to model discovery requests

question: Should Amazon Bedrock model discovery enforce the proposed fixed 30-second deadline for every foundation-model and inference-profile SDK request?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a deadline is needed, but code and tests cannot determine the acceptable latency budget for slow regions, proxies, retries, or large paginated profile catalogs.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Keep the proposed deadline because it bounds setup and refresh hangs while preserving the existing empty-catalog fallback.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose a different fixed deadline based on expected Bedrock control-plane latency and update the constant, proof, and tests accordingly.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed deadline because it bounds setup and refresh hangs while preserving the existing empty-catalog fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on Amazon Bedrock request-policy behavior and shared provider implementation.
